Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**THE RECORD BREAKER**

FADE IN:

INT. WORLD RECORD OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and camera crews. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is escorted to a podium, where a plaque awaits him.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, It Is Our Pleasure To Present The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live, Held By The Incomparable Jasper Jenkins!

Jasper Steps Up To The Podium, A Look Of Pride On His Face. The Crowd Erupts In Cheers And Applause As He Accepts The Plaque.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper Lies In Bed, The Plaque From Earlier Displayed On His Nightstand. He Looks Up At The Ceiling, A Faraway Look In His Eyes.

JASPER (V.O)
I Remember Reading About This Theory Online, Back In My Youth. Quantum Immortality. The Idea That Our Universe Is A Multiverse, And That Every Time A Decision Is Made, The Universe Branches Off Into Infinite Parallel Universes.

He Begins To Speak In A Hushed Tone, His Voice Rising In Excitement.

JASPER (V.O)
It Said That If You Made The Right Choices, You Could Live Forever. That You Could Be The Oldest Person In The Multiverse.

As Jasper Continues To Speak, His Voice Becomes More Frenzied. He Starts To Rock Back And Forth In Bed, His Eyes Wide With Madness.

JASPER (V.O)
But What If I'm Not Alone? What If There Are Others Out There, Living Forever In Parallel Universes? What If I'm Just A Drop In The Ocean, A Small Part Of A Much Larger Whole?

Jasper's Voice Drops To A Whisper, His Body Shaking With Sobs.

JASPER (V.O)
I Don't Want To Die. I Don't Want To Leave This World Behind. I Want To Keep Living, Forever And Ever.

Suddenly, Jasper's Body Goes Still. He Lies There, Frozen In Time, His Mind Consumed By The Weight Of His Own Immortality.

FADE TO BLACK.

**THE END**
